output.text: The robotics workshop filled the community hall with the buzz of small motors and the smell of fresh solder. Assume that Noor is the head judge. Tables were arranged in a wide semicircle so every entrant could see the central testing arena. Nell arrived early, carrying her tote bag of spare wheels and a spool of copper wire, and she chatted with Kira about gear ratios while the organizers finished setting up the scoring board. Leo drove the minibus. Ivo, who is a year older than Kira, spent the morning tightening the joints on his robotic arm, occasionally glancing at the clock. Nell finished ahead of Ivo. The workshop instructor called everyone together to review safety rules before the timed trials began, and Kira nodded along while sketching a quick diagram in her notebook. Ivo finished ahead of Kira. Outside, the afternoon light slanted through tall windows, catching the metallic frames of half-finished robots lined up along the back wall. Nell finished ahead of Kira. Noor is taller than Leo but shorter than Nell, a fact that came up when they all lined up for a group photo near the refreshment table. Kira, who had traveled the farthest that morning, took a short break to stretch before the next round of testing resumed. Leo mentioned that the drive over had taken longer than expected because of roadwork near the highway exit. By the time the sun began to set, everyone gathered their tools, packed away their robots, and compared notes about the day's builds, already looking forward to the next workshop scheduled for spring.
